# New York Film Academy (NYFA)

> > New York Film Academy (NYFA) is a leading visual and performing arts institution offering hands-on education in filmmaking, game design, photography, acting, animation, and related creative disciplines.

NYFA provides professional training through intensive programs taught by industry practitioners. The institution emphasizes practical, project-based learning across multiple campuses including New York City and offers resources covering film production, game development, Broadway performance, photography techniques, and entertainment industry trends.

## Key Topics

- Film Production & Cinematography
- Game Design & Development
- Photography & Visual Arts
- Acting & Performance
- Animation & Illustration
- Documentary Filmmaking
- Broadway & Musical Theater
- Producing & Project Ownership
- Industry Trends & Technology
- Portfolio Development
- Film Festivals (Tribeca, Oscars)
- Hands-on Education
- Creative Collaboration
- Entertainment Industry

## Film Production & Industry Guidance

- [How Can I Own My Producing Project?](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/how-can-i-own-my-producing-project): Neal Weisman explains project ownership, rights, and option agreements
- [How Can You Get Your Short Into The Tribeca Film Festival?](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/can-get-short-tribeca-film-festival): Guide to submitting short films to Tribeca Film Festival with insider tips
- [Camera Trends of 2015: 4K Cameras Under $1k, SD cards and NFC](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/camera-trends-of-2015): Overview of 2015 cinematography equipment trends including affordable 4K
- [Billy Wilder](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/billy-wilder): Profile of legendary director Billy Wilder and his essential films
- [Oscars 2019: The Best Documentary Short Nominees](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/2019-oscars-best-documentary-short-nominees): Review of 91st Academy Awards Best Documentary Short nominees
- [Dear Evan Hansen: The Pros And Cons Of Adapting Broadway Material To The Big Screen](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/dear-evan-hansen-the-pros-and-cons-of-adapting-broadway-material-to-the-big-screen): Analysis of Broadway to film adaptations using Dear Evan Hansen as example

## Faculty & Student Interviews

- [Q&A With Chris Swain, Chair, Game Design Dept., New York Film Academy](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/qa-with-chris-swain): Interview with Game Design Chair Chris Swain on prototyping & collaboration
- [Q&A With Brian Dilg, Chair, Photography Dept., New York Film Academy](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/qa-brian-dilg-chair-photography-department): Photography Chair Brian Dilg discusses technical skills & creative practice
- [Never Waste A Second: An Interview With Diego Foyo](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/qa-w-diego-foyo): Producer Diego Foyo on film education and hands-on learning at NYFA
- [Every Person Has A Story: An Interview With Documentary Filmmaker Susanne Dollnig](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/every-person-story-interview-documentary-filmmaker-susanne-dollnig): Austrian filmmaker Susanne Dollnig on documentary career and NYFA education

## Game Design & Development

- [4 Insanely Useful Game Design Books Every Designer Should Read](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/game-design-books): Essential game design reading list featuring Fullerton and Schell
- [Genre Revival: 2D Platformers](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/genre-revival-2d-platformers): History and resurgence of 2D platformer games from Donkey Kong to indies

## Photography & Visual Arts

- [The Diary Aesthetic: Raw & Gritty Photography Is Taking Center Stage](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/diary-aesthetic-raw-and-gritty-photography): Exploration of raw diary aesthetic in contemporary photography trends
- [5 Of The Most Influential And Famous Illustrators of ALL Time](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/5-of-the-most-influential-and-famous-illustrators-of-all-time): Survey of influential illustrators from Schultz to Watterson

## Acting & Performance Arts

- [10 Essential Twitter Accounts for Actors](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/10-essential-twitter-accounts-actors): Curated list of Twitter accounts for actors seeking industry resources
- [Ballet And Modern Dance: Using Ballet as the Basis for Other Dance Techniques](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/ballet-and-modern-dance): How ballet technique forms foundation for modern and contemporary dance
- [8 Broadway Shows You Need To See in 2019](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/8-broadway-shows-2019): Curated guide to must-see Broadway and Off-Broadway shows in NYC 2019
- [Broadway On The Small Screen: 4 Musicals That Need TV Revivals](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/broadway-small-screen-4-musicals-need-tv-revivals): Suggestions for Broadway musicals that deserve live TV adaptations

## Optional

- [The Most Anticipated 2015 Animated Movies](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/most-anticipated-2015-animated-movies): Preview of 2015 animated films from Pixar, Disney, and other studios
- [10 Superheroes Who Deserve A Movie](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/10-superheroes-who-deserve-a-movie): Underrated comic book characters who deserve Hollywood adaptations
